statements.t: Given the anticipated timing of the proposed Merger with North Immunology, we have a limited window in which to complete enrollment.
We intend to conclude patient recruitment in connection with the proposed Merger and subsequently compile the available clinical data for analysis.

risks.t: the risk that the proposed Merger with North Immunology, Inc. may not be completed on the anticipated terms or within the anticipated timeframe, or at all
the failure to obtain required stockholder approvals or satisfy other closing conditions, including completion of the contemplated financing
the potential termination of the Merger Agreement and the consequences thereof
the ability of the combined company to satisfy applicable Nasdaq listing requirements
the Company’s ability to manage its operations, expenses and liquidity pending completion of the Merger
the availability and adequacy of capital to support the Company’s ongoing obligations
the Company’s ability to implement planned operational changes and wind down certain legacy business activities
the Company’s ability to enroll additional patients in its Phase 1 oncology clinical trial in Australia and compile and analyze available clinical data
uncertainties regarding the timing and results of its clinical activities
the Company’s ability to monetize its legacy Hemopurifier business
the possibility that holders of contingent value rights may not receive any payments
unforeseen changes in regulatory requirements or other circumstances affecting the Company’s operations
